name: keyframe-to-video
description: Turn a product, scene or ad idea into a short video with sound: design a keyframe with GPT Image 2.5 on fal, get it approved, then animate it with MiniMax H3 Max image-to-video (camera move, ambience, optional dialogue). Use this whenever the user wants a short clip, a product video, a social ad or an animated still from an idea or an image, especially when the look must be controlled before paying for video.

steps.purpose: The first frame of the video, at the video's aspect ratio, with room for the planned motion
steps.check: Subject, setting and composition match the request; there is space for the camera move; no text or watermark. The video inherits every flaw of this frame.

steps.purpose: The user approves the keyframe before any video is paid for
steps.check: Show the keyframe and the planned motion, camera, sound, resolution, duration and price; continue only on a yes.

steps.purpose: Animate the approved keyframe (768P draft first; 1080P for delivery)
steps.check: Watch it: the subject stays stable, the camera does what was asked, no text or morphing, the sound fits. Read the manifest's duration and has_audio.
